token.name: A Funeral For Every Dead Token

notes: LaunchToken is the fixed-supply WAKE token (1,000,000,000 at 18 decimals, minted to the factory). Graveyard takes one constructor argument, its immutable owner, set to the launch's owner ($owner). After launch the owner calls setWakeToken once with the deployed LaunchToken address (it cannot be changed afterwards), consecrates buriable tokens (append-only, WAKE excluded) and funds WAKE rewards, which the owner can never withdraw. Mourners bury their entire balance of a consecrated token to 0x...dEaD, once per wallet per token, and receive 0.05% of the Graveyard's WAKE balance. Flowers burn WAKE to 0x...dEaD. No ETH is accepted and no initialization calls are made.
